body:
## Broader MRM source audit: supporting metadata verified; exact Skyline asset identified

This updates the earlier candidate screen. Registered Presto family `2026-10-25_1451_codex_mrm-anchor-admission` has now retrieved and independently audited supporting files. No model was trained and no raw amount–signal training recipe is admitted.

- **Michaud2018 / PASS01163 / PASS01200:** all eight XLSX supplements and their descriptions are retrieved. XML/openpyxl replay agrees at60,825 stored-cell positions across ten sheets. Data1 supplies500 unique standard sequences, AAA stock concentrations, CZE purity, adjusted stock concentrations, and heavy/light precursor/quantifier m/z. All500 stock corrections were checked; two small differences are consistent with three-decimal rounding and remain unmodified. These are stock solution concentrations, not injected doses. The table called raw data contains inferred plasma concentrations; the supplements do not supply separate isotope-channel areas. [Primary study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6123701/)
- **Sobsey2025 / PASS05890:** both XLSX supplements pass14,507 independent stored-cell checks. They provide transition settings and characterization summaries. TableS3 yields48 assay/peptide links with independent PDF-parser and visual agreement, versus53 assays in the title; preserve that unreconciled panel distinction. The exact selected CPTAC6077 link resolves to the McGill_Sobsey Panorama folder, which requires sign-in. [Primary study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11812018/)
- **Concrete processed asset:** the public [PASS05890 inventory](https://db.systemsbiology.net/sbeams/cgi/PeptideAtlas/PASS_View?identifier=PASS05890) lists `CPTAC_Exp1_Curves_CS.sky` at7.8M, separately from its148M archive and26M cache. This is the next file to qualify; its numeric contents are not yet inspected. The repository-published FTP route requires TLS, then fails certificate hostname validation for `ftp.peptideatlas.org`. Zero document bytes were downloaded. Verification was not disabled; no private account or author outreach was used.

Requested next steps within this issue:
1. Qualify a repository-supported HTTPS/verified-FTPS route or public mirror for that exact small Skyline document. Avoid transferring the large raw/cache archives merely to obtain its XML.
2. Verify whether it retains separate heavy/light areas and explicit peptide/form/charge/transition × run × dose links. Preserve integration, normalization, missing/zero/bounded/rejected states, intended panel and preparation/replicate identity; do not infer amounts from signal magnitude or column order.
3. Curate the now-available stock/purity/transition metadata through existing evidence/catalog/material-context/calibration-applicability APIs. Keep stock versus injection quantities, species/material roles, digestion/spiking stage, targeted selection and protocol applicability explicit. The48-versus53 panel difference needs a disposition rather than invented negatives.
4. Admit a raw-response recipe only after signal/amount joins and independent conservation checks pass. LLOQ, ratios and plasma protein estimates are distinct endpoints and cannot substitute for calibrated absolute areas. MRM-to-DDA/DIA/MAPP/APC transfer remains unvalidated.

Operational correction: NCBI retired the legacy OA/FTP distribution in August2026. The current documented anonymous [PMC S3 route](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/tools/pmcaws/) successfully supplied both studies' supplements with official size/MD5 verification. Original sources and failed attempts are preserved; publication omits repository-published passwords embedded in raw HTML/error logs.


[Full registered audit, field contract, source receipts and reproduction](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/d40f51d00d68d928e342d2ce9c937b61f3c63b77/experiments/2026-10-25_1451_codex_mrm-anchor-admission/README.md).
